```{=html}
<style>#title-block-header { display: none; }</style>
```

```{r}
#| label: pubs-setup
#| include: false
source("helpers.R")
source("paper_utils.R")
papers <- pu_load_papers()
```

```{r}
#| label: publications
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

p <- pu_prepare(papers)

items <- paste0(
    '<li class="pub-item">',
    '<div class="pub-meta">', p$cat_html, p$award_html, "</div>",
    '<h3 class="pub-title"><a href="', p$page_url, '">', pu_esc(p$title), "</a></h3>",
    '<p class="pub-authors">', p$authors_html, "</p>",
    ifelse(nzchar(p$venue),
        paste0('<p class="pub-venue">', pu_esc(p$venue), "</p>"), ""
    ),
    '<div class="pub-links">', p$links, p$cite_btn, "</div>",
    p$cite_box,
    "</li>"
)

# newest first, grouped by the sheet's `year` column
ord <- order(p$year, p$pub_date, decreasing = TRUE)
items <- items[ord]
year_o <- p$year[ord]

cat('<div class="with-aside">')
cat('<div class="page-aside" role="complementary">', pu_profile_html(), "</div>", sep = "")
cat('<div class="page-main">')

cat('<h1 class="page-title">Publications</h1>')
cat('<p class="page-lede">Journal, conference, workshop, and preprints. ',
    "The full list is on ",
    '<a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=bWvJMcgAAAAJ&amp;hl=fr&amp;oi=ao" ',
    'target="_blank" rel="noopener">Google Scholar</a>.</p>',
    sep = ""
)

cat('<div class="pubs">')
for (y in unique(year_o)) {
    cat('<section class="pub-year-group">',
        '<h2 class="pub-year">', pu_esc(y), "</h2>",
        '<ol class="pub-list">',
        paste(items[year_o == y], collapse = ""),
        "</ol></section>",
        sep = ""
    )
}
cat("</div>")

cat("</div></div>")
cat(pu_cite_script())
```
